# KEKE Manager

> B2B SaaS platform connecting tour companies, travel agencies, and verified tourist transport drivers across Georgia. KEKE Manager is a marketplace and operations platform — not a taxi or transfer company. Companies and drivers connect directly; KEKE provides software, verification, GPS, vouchers, and chat.

## Company

- Name: KEKE Manager
- Type: B2B SaaS platform for tourist transport in Georgia
- Website: https://kekemanager.com

- Headquarters: Tbilisi, Georgia

## What KEKE Manager is

KEKE Manager is an ecosystem where tourism businesses publish trips and hire verified guide-drivers, fleet hosts, and hired drivers. The platform does not sell transfers or tours itself — it connects supply (drivers) with demand (tour companies and agencies).

## Target users

- Tour companies and DMCs — create bookings, assign drivers, manage fleet
- Travel agencies — find reliable transport partners without phone chains
- Guide-drivers — licensed guides with own vehicles; receive trip offers
- Hosts — drivers with multiple vehicles who hire and assign fleet drivers
- Hired drivers — experienced drivers seeking work with fleet hosts
- Freelance drivers — join the verified network and accept company bookings

## Key features

- Fleet management and driver assignment
- Real-time GPS tracking on live map
- 500+ verified drivers across Georgia
- Booking types: airport transfer, one-day tour, multi-day tour
- Structured locations (airport, train station, hotel, address)
- Auto-generated PDF vouchers for clients
- Three-way chat: tour company, host, driver
- Driver ratings and verification
- Booking history and status workflow
- 33 UI languages on landing; full app in Georgian, English, Russian
- 33+ cities across Georgia in the platform city directory
- Admin GPS overview for fleet operators

## Coverage

Popular tourism regions and cities include Tbilisi, Batumi, Kazbegi (Stepantsminda), Kutaisi, Borjomi, Kakheti (wine region), Mtskheta, and nationwide coverage through the driver network.
